project_goal: Build a tiny LLM for legal document summarization.
dataset_support_requirements: Need open-source legal-document datasets for summarization, English only, avoid personally identifiable information.
constraints_and_compliance: No private/confidential client data; output should be concise and plain-language.

selected_model.why: Strong, widely adopted small model suitable for summarization SFT/LoRA and good vLLM support.

backup_models.why: Popular robust backup with long context for legal documents.

selected_open_datasets.why: Open English legislative summarization dataset with strong fit for legal summaries.
Legal summarization pairs useful for training and evaluation.
